fact: On 22 July 2026 Morocco's government council adopted bill 52.26 creating an integrated national health information system built on a central health data platform, a shared medical record, a national health identifier and a unified public hospital system, with interoperability as a principle.
title: Collecte, gestion et échange des données : tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur le système national d'information numérique de santé
